summary: Full frontend E2E of NoSolo landing page + /support admin console. Submitted a ticket end-to-end, verified localStorage persistence (nosolo_tickets_stub), password gate flow (wrong+right), admin table row rendering, view details dialog, close/reopen/delete-cancel actions, search empty-state, session persistence across reload, and lock console. All 15 targeted checks passed.
passed: Landing page loads with 'Travel Solo.' hero and tagline
Nav links (Features/Safety/About/Feedback & Support) visible; contact link scrolls to contact-section
Empty-form and invalid-email submissions do NOT persist a ticket (validation blocks submit) — verified by localStorage remaining empty until valid submit
Valid form submission persists ticket to localStorage key 'nosolo_tickets_stub' with all fields (name/email/phone/type=bug/priority=high/subject/message/status=open)
Success toast appears: 'Thanks — message received / We usually reply within one working day.'
/support shows password gate dialog (Restricted area) immediately
Wrong password shows 'Incorrect password.' via admin-gate-error
Correct password 'Nosolo!23' unlocks and reveals admin-tickets-table
Submitted ticket appears as row with matching id
View (eye) icon opens admin-details-dialog containing subject and full message
Close (check) icon flips ticket to Closed; reopen (RotateCcw) button appears
Reopen flips back to Open; close button re-appears
Delete opens confirm alert-dialog; cancelling keeps the row
Search with non-matching term shows admin-empty-state
Session persists across page reload (no gate shown after reload)
Lock console button clears session and re-shows the password gate
notes: Inline validation error text was not captured by generic error selectors, but validation is functionally correct — invalid submissions did not persist tickets to localStorage. Not a blocker.
Firebase is intentionally stubbed via localStorage (FIREBASE_CONFIG has REPLACE_* placeholders) — MOCKED per user choice.
